name: Low Birthweight prediction benchmark
description: A benchmarking effort establishing and comparing key machine learning models and rebalancing strategies for predicting low birthweight outcomes and identifying risk factors.
evaluation_method: AUROC (primary), with supplementary F1, precision/recall and calibration metrics
reputation: Specialized clinical benchmark used in perinatal/medical ML research; modest adoption outside domain experts.
notes: Tabular clinical dataset often class-imbalanced and relatively small; privacy and dataset-shift concerns; evaluates rebalancing strategies; non-LLM benchmark.
